title: The Wyrm Priest
text: A priest of the dragons sits by the road in robes of scale, his skin burned glassy, his eyes gold. He blesses travelers who kneel with a light touch of fire. The ground around him is scorched in rings.

options.label: Kneel for his fire, trusting his gods to be gentle.

outcomes.text: The fire warms without burning, and the warmth stays on you like armor.

options.label: The bravest asks for the full blessing, whatever it leaves behind.

outcomes.text: They come out of the fire changed in small ways, and scarred in larger ones.

options.label: Refuse his blessing; you kneel to no dragon.
